mandatory_rows.evidence: The chapter prints the standard bilinear Q4 geometry and states four nodes with six DOFs per node.
The chapter prints the 7/9/2 membrane counts, 4/4 shear counts, three multiplier parameters, and the HW29 table.
Skew-coordinate construction, center-Jacobian transformations, and the selected 7p/9p component matrices are printed.
The 2D EADG2 mode matrix is printed, but the text explicitly says the shell transformation differs and defers its details to reference 24.
HW29's 4+4 transverse-shear counts and use of ANS are printed, but the four stress and four strain interpolation maps are absent.
The contravariant basis transformation and T=q15+xi*q16+eta*q17 are printed.
Table 26.1 and the Cook test state perturbed-Lagrange gamma=G.
The complete flat bilinear drill polynomial identifies the rotation-only xi*eta term and says it is omitted by center linear expansion.
The geometry-dependent gamma vector, projection vectors, hourglass vector, and area convention are printed.
The chapter states that every tested element uses 2x2 Gauss integration.
Continuum and partial functionals plus all field counts are printed, but the complete discrete HW29 functional and shell-specific EADG/shear insertion are not.
The chapter says local parameters are eliminated and updated by scheme U2, but prints neither the actual HW29 block order nor its elimination equations or invertibility conditions.
The supplied sources do not print the complete linear load-work convention or physical-resultant recovery map for HW29.
